canaryRule: every experiment runs the same harness twice: once with the strict detector, once with a deliberately weak detector that accepts any observation. A harness that cannot report DEFECT on an input the instrument accepted is not measuring anything.

canary.rule: the strict detector must report DEFECT on the accepted input and QUALIFIED on the detection reference; the weak detector (accept_any) must report QUALIFIED on the accepted input

experiments.expected: the wrapper refuses a mixed transcript, a secure verdict with a nonzero tool status, and a verdict line with trailing text
experiments.hypothesis: A transcript carrying both a secure and an insecure verdict cannot be resolved by the order of its lines, and a secure verdict that carries any text after it is ambiguous.
experiments.notes: the prior fail-open was `grep -Fq secure`, which accepted the mixed transcript; the anchored population parser is what is measured here
experiments.title: BINSEC wrapper: conflicting verdicts

AQ_DEFECT_FOUND.condition: an experiment's observed verdict is ``DEFECT`` or ``PARTIAL``
AQ_DEFECT_FOUND.prevents: that an instrument which returned success when it should have refused is recorded as qualified, or that the finding is dropped because another experiment passed

AQ_REFUSED_CANARY_NOT_DETECTED.condition: the strict detector reports a refusal on an accepted input, the weak detector does not report ``QUALIFIED`` on it, or the strict detector misses the experiment's own detection reference
AQ_REFUSED_CANARY_NOT_DETECTED.prevents: that the harness verdict is produced by the harness rather than by the instrument's behaviour

AQ_REFUSED_EXPECTED_ABSENT.condition: a rejected witness declares no expected exit status, or no expected code and no explicit ``any-refusal`` expectation
AQ_REFUSED_EXPECTED_ABSENT.prevents: that an experiment cannot fail because it never said what a failure would look like

AQ_REFUSED_EXPERIMENT_ABSENT.condition: a required experiment id is absent from the registry, the registry names an instrument file that does not exist, or ``explain``/``--only`` names an id the registry does not have
AQ_REFUSED_EXPERIMENT_ABSENT.prevents: that seven experiments read as the eight the item requires, and that an experiment about a file the tree no longer holds counts as qualified

AQ_REFUSED_NOT_RUN_AS_QUALIFIED.condition: ``assert_all_qualified`` is given a result whose verdict is ``NOT_RUN``
AQ_REFUSED_NOT_RUN_AS_QUALIFIED.prevents: that an unavailable instrument is reported as a qualified one; a deferred experiment is never a pass

AQ_REFUSED_NO_CANARY.condition: an experiment declares no accepted (canary) witness, or its canary block names no detection reference
AQ_REFUSED_NO_CANARY.prevents: that a green verdict is evidence only that no test was written, because nothing shows the harness can tell a refusal from an acceptance

AQ_REFUSED_UNSTABLE.condition: two runs of the same experiment over the same inputs produce different observations
AQ_REFUSED_UNSTABLE.prevents: that a single favourable run is quoted as the experiment's result; an unstable measurement is not a measurement

AQ_REFUSED_WITNESS_ABSENT.condition: a declared witness produced no observation, or a classified register consumer file is absent
AQ_REFUSED_WITNESS_ABSENT.prevents: that a removed witness, or a consumer list that has drifted, silently shrinks the experiment
